svg.text: Technique contributions (one technique off in the final configuration)
Frame p95 at N=10,000, moving orb
not distinguishable from the final configuration
frame p95 of the final configuration
Not distinguishable (frame p95 differs by under 0.5 ms or by less than a run range)
Sub-experiment: a technique is replaced, not removed
with engine avoidance instead of separation
Thick bar: frame p95, median of the runs used (3-4 runs). Thin bar: frame p50. Black line: range of the runs' frame p95.
Value in brackets: change of frame p95 from the final configuration, in ms.
Distinguishable: the change is at least 0.5 ms and larger than the larger run range of the two conditions.
† hydration off also removes the actor capsule, actor animation budget and actor mesh fixed bounds.
† ISKM off also removes ISKM fixed bounds, the track reserve and the far-hit rule.
† background crowd off also removes the far-hit rule and the drawing of off-map records.
